title: Preserve unchanged embedded asset timestamps
acceptance: PM accepted after independent required-build evidence; does not imply WPT parity
problem: The Python generator already skipped identical bytes, but CMake multiple OUTPUT rules touched every secondary include after a page prelude change.
change: One generation target declares the byproducts derived from the same shared/lazy source globs. Byte-preserving generator checks run before consumers and recover missing outputs. No generated runtime bytes changed by the build-graph patch.
ninja_status: Dependency semantics reviewed in official CMake documentation; Ninja execution was not performed.

required_build115.intentional_changed_include: prelude.inc while exact position patch was reversed for isolated font build
required_build115.unchanged_includes: All others retained identical hashes and mtimes

limitations: Always-run generation target adds a small check on each build; measured no-op target wall cost includes Make/Python startup and contemporaneous contention.
No claim of Ninja runtime verification or general build-speed percentage.
